subScenes.name: 迟到道歉
subScenes.description: 因迟到向朋友道歉，并简要说明交通堵塞原因。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友/同事因你迟到而询问原因，你需要道歉并解释

followUps.text: Sorry! My alarm didn’t go off, and I totally overslept.
followUps.text_cn: 对不起！闹钟没响，我睡过头了。

followUps.text: My bad—I got stuck in traffic and couldn’t get here any faster.
followUps.text_cn: 是我的错，路上堵车，我也没办法更快了。

followUps.text: I’m really sorry—I was helping a roommate with an emergency and lost track of time.
followUps.text_cn: 真的很抱歉，我在帮室友处理紧急情况，结果忘了时间。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友或同事间因迟到被问及时的自然道歉与解释，语气诚恳但不过度辩解

qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你迟到了20分钟，有原因吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事因你严重迟到而直接质问，需快速道歉并给出合理解释

followUps.text: I know, I’m so sorry—I had a flat tire and had to call roadside assistance.
followUps.text_cn: 我知道，真的很抱歉，我爆胎了，只好叫了道路救援。

followUps.text: I’m really sorry—I thought the meeting was at 3, not 2:30.
followUps.text_cn: 非常抱歉，我以为会议是3点，不是2:30。

followUps.text: No excuse—I just messed up. I’ll make it up to you.
followUps.text_cn: 没什么借口，是我搞砸了，我会补偿你的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于较正式的同事关系或较严肃的迟到场景，回应需体现责任感与成熟度

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因你多次迟到而语气不满，需真诚道歉并承诺改变

followUps.text: I know I’ve been late a few times—I’m working on it. This won’t happen again.
followUps.text_cn: 我知道我几次都迟到了，我正在改进，这次不会再发生了。

followUps.text: You’re right—I’ve been careless. Can I buy you coffee to make it up?
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对，我太粗心了。我请你喝杯咖啡补偿好吗？

followUps.text: I’m really sorry—I’ve been overwhelmed with work lately. I’ll set reminders to be on time.
followUps.text_cn: 真的很抱歉，最近工作太忙了。我会设提醒，保证准时。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于有重复迟到行为的社交关系，回应需包含情绪承认+具体改进，避免防御性语气

subScenes.name: 解释原因
subScenes.description: 诚恳说明失误背后的具体情况，避免显得推卸责任。

qaPairs.triggerText: I'm really sorry I was late again — my bus broke down and there was no backup route.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 真的很抱歉我又迟到了——公交车坏了，而且没有其他路线可选。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因交通问题迟到并解释原因，你如何回应？

followUps.text: No worries, accidents happen. Thanks for letting me know!
followUps.text_cn: 别担心，意外总会发生，谢谢你告诉我！

followUps.text: I get it, but can you try to leave earlier next time? I had to reschedule my meeting.
followUps.text_cn: 我理解，但下次能早点出发吗？我不得不改掉我的会议。

followUps.text: Hmm, this is the third time this month — can we find a better way to handle this?
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，这已经是本月第三次了——我们能不能想想更好的解决办法？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友或同事因突发状况迟到/失约时的道歉回应，体现不同态度层级：宽容、有边界、寻求改进

qaPairs.triggerText: Sorry I missed your call — I was in a meeting and my phone was on silent.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 抱歉没接到你的电话——我在开会，手机调成静音了。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事因开会错过电话而道歉，你如何回应？

followUps.text: Totally fine — meetings come first. Just text me next time if it’s urgent.
followUps.text_cn: 完全没问题——开会优先。下次紧急的话发个短信就行。

followUps.text: Oh, I was kinda worried — next time can you just send a quick 'in meeting' message?
followUps.text_cn: 哦，我有点担心了，下次能发个‘在开会’的简短消息吗？

followUps.text: That’s okay, but I really needed to talk to you about the project — can we jump on a call now?
followUps.text_cn: 没关系，但我真的很需要和你聊聊项目——我们现在能通个电话吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场朋友/同事因工作原因失联后的道歉回应，体现从包容到主动推进的多种态度

qaPairs.triggerText: I’m so sorry I forgot your birthday — I’ve been swamped with deadlines and completely lost track of time.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 真的很抱歉忘了你的生日——我最近截止日期堆成山，完全忘了时间。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因忙碌忘记重要日子而道歉，你如何回应？

followUps.text: Aww, I know you’ve been crazy busy — it’s the thought that counts. Let’s grab coffee this weekend?
followUps.text_cn: 哎呀，我知道你最近忙疯了，心意最重要。这周末一起喝杯咖啡吧？

followUps.text: I was a little hurt, but I understand. Just don’t let it happen again — birthdays matter to me.
followUps.text_cn: 我有点受伤，但我理解。只是别再这样了——生日对我来说很重要。

followUps.text: You forgot my birthday? Wow… I guess we need to talk about how we prioritize things.
followUps.text_cn: 你忘了我生日？哇……我想我们得谈谈彼此如何优先安排事情了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于亲密朋友间因疏忽重要纪念日的道歉，回应体现从温暖包容到情感预警的多层次反应

subScenes.name: 表达歉意
subScenes.description: 使用真诚语气重申歉意，强调对方的重要性。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey, you forgot to text me back about the movie plans.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嘿，你忘了回我关于电影安排的消息了。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因未收到回复而略带不满，你需要道歉并解释

followUps.text: I'm really sorry—I got swamped with work and totally lost track of time.
followUps.text_cn: 真的很抱歉，我工作太忙，完全忘了时间。

followUps.text: You're right, my bad—I’ll buy you coffee next week to make it up.
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对，是我错了，下周我请你喝咖啡补偿。

followUps.text: Oops, sorry about that! I’ve been juggling a few things—can we reschedule?
followUps.text_cn: 啊，不好意思！最近事情有点多，我们能重新约个时间吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友间因沟通延迟产生的轻微摩擦，回应需平衡真诚与轻松语气，避免过度辩解

qaPairs.triggerText: I noticed you were late to the team lunch again.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我注意到你又迟到了团队午餐。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事委婉指出你多次迟到，需表达歉意并说明情况

followUps.text: I know I’ve been late a few times—I’m working on being more punctual, and I appreciate you pointing it out.
followUps.text_cn: 我知道我迟到了几次，我正在努力改进，谢谢你提醒我。

followUps.text: Sorry about that—I had a bad commute today, but I’ll leave earlier from now on.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，今天交通太糟了，但从现在开始我会早点出发。

followUps.text: You’re right—I shouldn’t have done that. I’ll make sure to be there on time next time.
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对，我不该这样。下次我一定准时到。

qaPairs.usageNote: 职场社交中对重复性失误的回应，语气需专业但不僵硬，避免推卸责任

qaPairs.triggerText: You didn’t show up to my birthday dinner… I was really looking forward to it.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你没来参加我的生日晚餐……我真的很期待见到你。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因你缺席重要聚会而感到受伤，需真诚道歉并安抚情绪

followUps.text: I’m so sorry—I had an emergency with my mom and couldn’t get out of it. I feel terrible for missing it.
followUps.text_cn: 我真的很抱歉，我妈妈出了急事，实在脱不开身。错过你的聚会我太难过了。

followUps.text: I know I let you down, and I don’t have a good excuse. Can I take you out for dinner this weekend?
followUps.text_cn: 我知道我让你失望了，也没法找借口。这周末我请你吃顿饭好吗？

followUps.text: I can’t believe I missed it—I’ve been so distracted lately. Can I make it up to you with a proper celebration?
followUps.text_cn: 我真不敢相信我错过了，最近我太心不在焉了。我能为你补办一次正式的庆祝吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于亲密关系中的严重疏忽，回应需包含情感承认、责任承担和修复行动，避免轻率敷衍

subScenes.name: 提出补偿
subScenes.description: 主动提议请客或帮忙作为弥补，缓和气氛。

qaPairs.triggerText: I really messed up on the presentation — I owe you one. How about I cover dinner this weekend?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我真把演示搞砸了，欠你一个人情。这周末我请吃饭怎么样？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友道歉并提出请客补偿

followUps.text: That’s so kind of you — I’d love that!
followUps.text_cn: 你太贴心了，我太愿意了！

followUps.text: Thanks, but let’s just forget it — no need to treat me.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，但别放在心上，不用请客了。

followUps.text: How about we split a meal and you get the next one? I don’t want you to feel pressured.
followUps.text_cn: 不如我们AA，下次你再请？我不想让你有压力。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友或同事道歉后提出补偿时，对方可能的三种典型回应：接受、拒绝、协商替代方案。

qaPairs.triggerText: Sorry I missed our study session — I’ll buy you coffee next week and help you review the notes.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 抱歉错过了我们的学习会，下周我请你喝咖啡，帮你复习笔记。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事道歉并提出补习+请咖啡补偿

followUps.text: Coffee and notes? Perfect — let’s do it Thursday after class.
followUps.text_cn: 咖啡加笔记？太棒了，我们周四下课后吧。

followUps.text: Actually, I’m good — you don’t need to do both. Just send me the notes if you can.
followUps.text_cn: 其实不用这么麻烦，你只要把笔记发我就行。

followUps.text: I appreciate it, but I’m swamped next week — can we push it to the weekend?
followUps.text_cn: 我很感激，但我下周超忙，能推迟到周末吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于学术或工作场景中因失约而提出的补偿，回应需体现时间灵活性与关系边界。

qaPairs.triggerText: I accidentally spilled coffee on your laptop — I’m so sorry. I’ll pay for the repair or replace it.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我不小心把咖啡洒在你笔记本上了，太抱歉了，我来付维修费或者换一台新的。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事因意外损坏物品提出赔偿

followUps.text: Wow, that’s incredibly generous — let’s go to the repair shop together and split the cost.
followUps.text_cn: 天啊，你太慷慨了，我们一起去维修店，费用平摊吧。

followUps.text: It’s just a scratch — don’t worry about it. I’ll fix it myself.
followUps.text_cn: 只是划痕而已，别放在心上，我自己能修。

followUps.text: If you’re serious, maybe you can cover the repair and I’ll get you a new keyboard as a thank-you?
followUps.text_cn: 如果你真想补偿，不如你付维修费，我送你个新键盘当谢礼？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于物品损坏后的赔偿提议，回应需体现对价值、关系和互惠的不同态度。

subScenes.name: 修复关系
subScenes.description: 以积极话题收尾，重建轻松互动的氛围。

qaPairs.triggerText: I know I blew off our plans last weekend — I really messed up.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我知道我放了你鸽子，上周六的计划我搞砸了。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因取消计划而道歉，你需要回应以修复关系

followUps.text: Hey, I was upset at first, but I get it — life gets busy. Thanks for saying something.
followUps.text_cn: 我一开始确实有点生气，但我理解，生活总会有事。谢谢你主动说。

followUps.text: I appreciate you apologizing, but I need a little time to feel okay about it again.
followUps.text_cn: 我很感谢你道歉，但我需要一点时间才能重新感觉舒服。

followUps.text: Thanks for owning up — how about we reschedule this weekend? My treat this time.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你承认错误——这周末我们重新约吧？这次我请客。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友或同事因失约、忽视或冒犯而道歉时，学习者可选择不同态度回应，体现情感成熟度

qaPairs.triggerText: I shouldn’t have said that in the meeting — I was out of line.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我不该在会议上那样说，我确实越界了。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在公开场合言辞不当后道歉，你需要回应以缓和气氛

followUps.text: I was surprised at the time, but I know you didn’t mean it that way. Let’s just move forward.
followUps.text_cn: 我当时确实有点意外，但我知道你不是那个意思。咱们往前看吧。

followUps.text: It hurt a bit, and I’m not sure I can forget it easily — can we talk privately later?
followUps.text_cn: 那句话让我有点受伤，我不确定能轻易忘记——我们稍后能私下聊聊吗？

followUps.text: I’m glad you said that. Next time, maybe check in with me first if it’s something personal?
followUps.text_cn: 很高兴你这么说。下次如果是私人话题，能不能先跟我打个招呼？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场中因言语冒犯道歉的场景，回应需平衡情绪表达与关系修复

qaPairs.triggerText: I know I’ve been distant lately — I didn’t mean to make you feel ignored.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我知道我最近有点冷淡，我不是想让你觉得被忽视了。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因情感疏远而道歉，你需要回应以重建连接

followUps.text: I missed our chats, but I’m really glad you reached out. Let’s grab coffee this week?
followUps.text_cn: 我真的很想念我们的聊天，很高兴你主动联系了。这周一起喝杯咖啡？

followUps.text: I felt left out, but I also know you’ve been stressed. I just wish you’d told me what was going on.
followUps.text_cn: 我确实感到被冷落了，但我也知道你最近压力大。我只是希望你能告诉我你在经历什么。

followUps.text: It’s okay — I’ve been busy too. Maybe we can just start slow, like texting once a week?
followUps.text_cn: 没关系，我最近也挺忙的。也许我们可以慢慢来，比如每周发一次消息？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于情感疏远后的修复对话，回应需体现共情、自我反思与可操作的重建方案
